summary: MSD Investment Corp., an externally managed BDC, filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Fourth Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust as trustee for a $350 million private placement of 6.875% unsecured notes due October 15, 2029. Interest pays semiannually from April 15, 2027; notes are redeemable at the company's option and carry a change-of-control repurchase right at 100% plus accrued interest upon a change of control and below-investment-grade ratings from Fitch and Moody's. Proceeds repay facility debt and fund general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; monitor leverage and coverage.
